scope: Existing thymine-pair conversion and same-strand/different-strand support; prerequisite audit for MVP isomer selection
verified: Existing convert_extra_pair builds cis-syn CPD coordinates and both crosslinks for junction extra thymines on the same strand or different strands.
Regression fixtures preserve CPD core distances, strand ownership, existing bonds and unselected atom coordinates across conversion and normalized-design save/reload.

Existing place_product_template supports ordinary and extra endpoints in both strand relationships; synthetic geometry tests exercise all four combinations. This is not qualification of arbitrary DNA contexts.

fix.problem: Legacy load reclassification from Crossover to ForcedLigation discarded the junction ID and extra_bases, making CPD endpoints and saved poses stale.
fix.resolution: Preserve ID and inserted sequence for both mismatched-bp and non-neighbor reclassification.

remaining_for_general_isomer_selection: Editor conversion selection, pose storage and native job admission are currently restricted to junction extra bases; ordinary backbone thymines need integration.
Production conversion currently admits cis-syn only. The four archived MVP packages are provisional candidates, not production registry releases; see cpd_mvp_final_scope_audit_20261017.json.
minimize_attachment_bonds reloads the default cis-syn template. Propagate the selected isomer before enabling other templates, including re-relaxation.
add_design_bonds and preview crosslinks currently assume syn C5-C5/C6-C6 connectivity. Reuse chemical-definition graph_delta for anti products.
Preserve explicit ordered endpoint stereochemistry and version native source/template/engine contracts when adding isomers.
Saving generic photoproduct intent through preflight is not evidence that product coordinates were built. Keep authoring availability separate from simulation qualification.
compatibility: models.py is included in the native CPD engine digest. Previously pinned recipes may report an engine mismatch under the existing strict verification contract; no pins are silently refreshed.
